method.comparison: Same deterministic scenarios through the production match crossfade. Current LBS isolates skinning changes; baseline LBS includes the original proportions, rig and skinning.
method.frozenWeightJacobian: Central finite differences in XYZ with epsilon 0.1 mm for DQ, exact affine derivative for LBS. Skin weights are held fixed, so determinant 1 is not an anatomical tissue-volume measurement.
method.surfaceArea: Actual deformed indexed triangles divided by their bind triangle areas; a two-dimensional surface Jacobian that includes spatially changing vertex weights.
method.sections: Actual triangle-plane intersections near each bind joint, cut perpendicular to its transported average bone axis. The convex hull area measures the outer section silhouette and may bridge concavities; it is not enclosed tissue volume.
method.orientation: A reversed triangle is measured against its locally transported bind normal. Adjacent foldback counts smooth bind-neighbor triangles whose deformed normals oppose each other; it is a surface diagnostic, not a full self-intersection test.
method.intersections: Strict interior segment/triangle tests on nonadjacent joint-region triangles after an AABB rejection. Shared/coincident bind vertices, coplanar and boundary-only contact are excluded. Counts are a lower bound on transverse self-penetration, and include any already present in the bind-region reference.
method.limitations: The material-split human surface is open. Whole human tissue volume, robust watertight collision checking, anatomical artist review, and actual device performance are not established by this report.
